paragraphs.text: The Dragonstorm Arc is the one-year storyline that followed the Omenpath Arc . It is the second part of a three-year story arc codenamed Metronome . It comprises the premier sets Bloomburrow , Duskmourn: House of Horror , Aetherdrift and Tarkir: Dragonstorm .

The Dragonstorm Arc started in July 2024 and features the following sets: Bloomburrow , Duskmourn: House of Horror , Aetherdrift and Tarkir: Dragonstorm . While not containing story elements, Alchemy: Bloomburrow , Alchemy: Duskmourn , and Alchemy: Aetherdrift are also set within the Dragonstorm Arc.

After Ugin left Tarkir , dragonstorms on the plane have gone out-of-control. In combination with the newly formed Omenpaths , this has resulted in dragons appearing on other planes. Meanwhile, Jace and Vraska travel from plane to plane with Loot , laying the groundwork for a plot that spans the entire Multiverse.
Following the conclusion of the Dragonstorm Arc, the Metronome story arc continues with the Echoverse Arc .
